Charts, Bestenlisten, Durchschnitt: Oft: Charts, top lists, averages: often you don't just want to see rows, you want to put them in order or add them up. With ORDER BY you sort, with LIMIT you take only the first ones – and COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX calculate for you. Even over a million rows, in an instant.
